sources.title: UCSD Facilities public Atkinson Hall Level 1 room listing
sources.publisher: UC San Diego Facilities Information System
sources.revision: Public listing accessed 2026-10-22; metadata revision unspecified.
sources.use: Room key 31372 is listed as 1511 on Floor 1, area 2865 sqft. The area is the sole scale constraint, not an independent geometry validation.

scale.note: The trace has no reliable dimension or scale bar. sqrt(listedSqft * 0.09290304 / tracedPixelArea) is used for approximate metric display. Agreement with 2865 sqft is imposed, not independent verification.

boundaryNotes: Trace follows the principal visible inner enclosure of the lower fixed-tier auditorium, including its stage. Stage-side entry offsets and audience-entry recesses are retained; door openings are closed at the threshold, rather than following open door leaves.
The upper black-box theater, pre-function lobby, left-side long narrow access corridor, and right-side shaded corridor are excluded.

Minor wall thickness changes, columns and door hardware are simplified. Curved seat rows and tier heights are not reconstructed; the polygon represents the room extent, not a detailed seating or accessibility model.

limitations: Only the L1 auditorium room is modeled. The outline represents its perimeter and is not a complete floor plan or a building exterior.

The official QI event diagram is undated. Historical SEAW page 7 supplies the explicit Main Auditorium–1511 crosswalk; present public FIS metadata confirms room number, floor and area. These sources do not establish modern as-built accuracy or confirm that no intervening changes occurred.
Metric display scale is calibrated from a single room area (2865 sqft). There is no independent scale dimension or area validation, and boundary measurement conventions may differ.
North is unknown and no campus georeference is present. Drawing-axis local coordinates must not be overlaid on the campus map.
Tier heights and total room height are unknown; the renderer uses an explicitly estimated 4 m extrusion.

The original Facilities layout remains preserved at static/indoor/facilities/CALIT.json with B and L1–L7 outlines. Its eight-floor shell is not merged into this independent single-room coordinate frame.
